Why: this card's own precondition is 「open the PR only after stage 8 (S8) is on `main`」. Read on #15204 at 2026-10-12T08:08Z: the stage-8 report (comment 6118994290, 2026-10-12T06:28Z) says S8 is 「pushed, no PR while #22900 is unmerged」 and 「Lands after #22900 (D) and after the S8-T tests」; PR #22900 (stage 6b-2, D) is an open draft, PR #22962 (S8-T) is an open draft, and no S8 PR exists yet. So the unblock is a chain — #22900 merges → #22962 merges → the S8 PR is opened and merges → this card's PR may open. The `Blocked-by:` line names the nearest upstream, #22900; when it closes the unlock scan re-derives the next blocker (expected: the S8 PR) rather than releasing. The epic seat's promised 「S8 on `main`」 comment on this card is the human half of the same signal.

Dispatch plan: this seat dispatches one dev when S8 is on `main` — one round, one Tier H draft PR over the ten ADRs, the ADR texts re-read at that moment (ADR-0131 itself is being amended by the epic, so a draft prepared today would be judged against a tree that moves). If the epic seat wants the ADR notes drafted earlier for review alongside S8, say so here and the seat will dispatch a draft-only round on request.

Lane effect: with this card out of the open queue, the lane's P0/P1 count is 0 and its p3 tooling cards may dispatch as slots free (North Star 优先级 rule 3).
